page.overview:
Who is Boonta Eve?

Boonta Eve was a male fathier with brown fur and black eyes the planet and was held in the city Canto Bight on the planet Cantonica. By the time of the race, they stood 283 centimeters tall and weighed 967 kilograms. While Boonta Eve was moving to the starting line a announcer for the Canto Cup stated that the fathier was hoping to get payback after the previous racing season.

That year, Boonta Eve competed in a race that was watched via hologram, and bet on, by the outlaw Kay Vess.

Boonta Eve appeared in the 2024 Massive Entertainment video game Star Wars Outlaws as one of the fathiers that can be randomly assigned in the optional Canto Fathier Racing activity. For every race in the game, six jockeys are assigned a random fathier and a random color uniform and symbol. As such, this article does not assume one pairing or uniform color to be canonical.
